## Summary

Describe the Instant On or Home Assistant behavior changed by this pull request.

## Validation

- [ ] Python modules compile.
- [ ] JSON files validate.
- [ ] Hassfest passes.
- [ ] HACS validation passes.
- [ ] Optional API endpoints fail gracefully.
- [ ] The privacy check passes.
- [ ] Diagnostics and logs contain no credentials or identifying client data.

## Security and privacy

Confirm that the change remains read-only and does not expose credentials,
tokens, cookies, site UUIDs, serial numbers, MAC addresses, IP addresses, or
client records. Examples use neutral site and device names.
